```{r load packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
my_wd_all_dat <- "project_dir"

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

## Input data
- prepared parcel data
- administrative boundaries
- population development in administrative boundaries

```{r read data, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dat_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_05_2023.gpkg") 
```

## Create final dataset
- We exclude parcels with non-reliable information: 
  * age of inhabitants is < 16 or 
- We exclude the use category "unbenannte Straße/Weg", which we did not exclude in the beginning because some are part of a parcel which are merged together as a building overlaps.
- We introduce a minimum parcel size of 100 m², as this is a realistic minimum size of a parcel for residential construction. 
- We exclude all parcels with a shp_par (Shape index) larger 2.5, as these are largely splinter polygons or strangely combines parcels which is most likely due to errors in the base data. 

```{r remove non-reliable information, include=FALSE}
dat_01 <- dat_raw %>% 
  filter(is.na(exclude_age)) %>% 
  select(-exclude_age) %>% 
  filter(use_name_par != "unbenannte Straße/Weg") %>%
  filter(area_par >= 100) %>% 
  filter(shp_par <= 2.5)
```

### Final dataset with sorted variables
```{r}
dat_fin <- dat_01 %>% 
  mutate(only_75_older_par = if_else(only_75_older_par == 1, TRUE, FALSE),
         under_16_present_par = if_else(under_16_present_par == 1, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  select(id_par_merge, parceltype, 
         area_par, shp_par, share_area_foot_par, share_floorspace_par, largest_nonbuiltup, use_cat_par_simple,
         fa_23, ucp_par, bldg_age_median, bldg_type,
         heritage_single, heritage_ensemble, mun_prop, bplan, 
         service_quality_2020, service_quality_chg, center_quality,
         HP_euro_qm, AR_euro_qm, brw,
         persons_total_par, persons_per_fa, ave_age_par, only_75_older_par, under_16_present_par,
         share_area_par_nbr, share_floorspace_par_nbr, apd_400m, 
         age_pop_mean_block, bldg_age_median_block, share_floorspace_par_block, 
         structure_type, bezirk, bezirksteil)

names(dat_fin)
```

## Write final dataset
```{r write data, include=FALSE}
st_write(dat_fin, "./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_06_2023_final.gpkg", delete_layer = TRUE)
```
